description: This Java source file defines the 'ShardingSuite' class, which extends JUnit's Suite to facilitate test sharding based on custom annotations and hashing strategies. It includes nested annotation 'ShardUsing' for specifying hashing strategies, methods for discovering test classes, and logic for filtering classes into shards based on system properties.
